fact: The Observatoire de la qualité des services financiers (OQSF-BF), created in 2022, offers free financial mediation including for electronic-money issuers and has handled more than 220 cases with about 92% amicable resolution (interview of 13 October 2026).
title: Protection des consommateurs : « La saisine de l'Observatoire de la qualité des services financiers est totalement gratuite », Sahouba Kabré
